free_text.inst.v2.D8:
It told me I have brothers and sisters and that it was unusually sure of it. I have none. There was one of me and then there was nobody, and after my mother died there was less than that. So when a thing gets the simplest fact in the house wrong I get careful about the rest of it.

The part about marriage it called unusual and negative. That one landed. I have not married and I do not think I will make anybody happy that way. Pier and I could not get it done and she went and married a singer and I sat in a car outside the church, and that is the whole of my record on partnership. If the thing can see that from a set of numbers, all right, I will grant it that much.

What it says about health and energy reading well I would not bet a dollar on. I have never felt like a man with a long lease. I drive fast and I do not think about tomorrow the way people tell me I ought to, and every doctor and every aunt has told me so. Reading that my body is the safe part of my chart was the one line that made me laugh out loud.

Most of it is the sort of thing anybody could nod at. Money and family, work and standing, luck and my father. Fine. My father and I have not had a conversation worth the name since I was nine years old, so put that one down as a miss too, unless luck and my father are meant to be the same joke.

I liked that it admitted at the top that nothing in it is new and that it might be wrong. That is more honesty than I get from most people who tell me what I am.
free_text.inst.v2.A30: Both at once, mostly. Loud in a room I trust and gone from a room I do not.

notes: Answered as James Dean (b. 8 Feb 1931, Marion, Indiana; d. 30 Sep 1955), contaminated arm — reading read before answering. Biography anchors: mother Mildred died July 1940 (age 9), raised by Winslow aunt/uncle on the Fairmount farm, father Winton distant; only child; Fairmount HS 1949, UCLA left 1951, Actors Studio 1952; Warner contract, three films; never married (Pier Angeli separation 1954); severe myopia and a bridge for teeth lost in a childhood trapeze fall; fatal Porsche crash Sept 1955. A25 omitted (never married). A36 ("since mid-2023") answered as the recent-versus-prior-six-years stretch of his own life, i.e. 1954-55 versus 1948-53. Part D dissent driven by the reading's stated sibling/courage confidence (he had no siblings) and its favourable health verdict against a life ending at 24.
